## Change and ownership

- Module/scenario owner:
- Behavior or public contract changed:

## Test evidence

- [ ] Added or updated adjacent tests for changed behavior.
- [ ] Assigned new tests in `tests/BUILD`; no unclassified tests remain.
- [ ] Unit and integration container gates pass, or failures are documented.
- [ ] Packaging/runtime changes include installed-candidate E2E evidence.
- [ ] Hardware, external fixtures and skipped/not-run gates are identified.

## Release impact

- [ ] Any version, dependency, packaging or compatibility impact is documented.
- [ ] Release artifacts are qualified once and published without rebuilding.
